comment:
* A set of attributes of class PKCS9Attribute.
 *
 * @author Douglas Hoover

variables.name: attributes
variables.comment: * Attributes in this set indexed by OID.

variables.name: permittedAttributes
variables.comment: * The keys of this hashtable are the OIDs of permitted attributes.

variables.name: derEncoding
variables.comment:
* The DER encoding of this attribute set.  The tag byte must be
     * DerValue.tag_SetOf.

variables.name: ignoreUnsupportedAttributes
variables.comment:
* Contols how attributes, which are not recognized by the PKCS9Attribute
     * class, are handled during parsing.

methods.name: private byte[] decode(DerInputStream in) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Decode this set of PKCS9 attributes from the contents of its
     * DER encoding. Ignores unsupported attributes when directed.
     *
     * @param in
     * the contents of the DER encoding of the attribute set.
     *
     * @exception IOException
     * on i/o error, encoding syntax error, unacceptable or
     * unsupported attribute, or duplicate attribute.

methods.name: public void encode(byte tag, OutputStream out) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Put the DER encoding of this PKCS9 attribute set on an
     * DerOutputStream, tagged with the given implicit tag.
     *
     * @param tag the implicit tag to use in the DER encoding.
     * @param out the output stream on which to put the DER encoding.
     *
     * @exception IOException  on output error.

methods.name: public byte[] getDerEncoding() throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Return the DER encoding of this attribute set, tagged with
     * DerValue.tag_SetOf.

methods.name: public PKCS9Attribute getAttribute(ObjectIdentifier oid)
methods.comment: * Get an attribute from this set.

methods.name: public PKCS9Attribute getAttribute(String name)
methods.comment: * Get an attribute from this set.

methods.name: public PKCS9Attribute[] getAttributes()
methods.comment: * Get an array of all attributes in this set, in order of OID.

methods.name: public Object getAttributeValue(ObjectIdentifier oid) throws IOException
methods.comment: * Get an attribute value by OID.

methods.name: public Object getAttributeValue(String name) throws IOException
methods.comment: *  Get an attribute value by type name.

methods.name: public String toString()
methods.comment: * Returns the PKCS9 block in a printable string form.

methods.name: static DerEncoder[] castToDerEncoder(Object[] objs)
methods.comment: * Cast an object array whose components are * DerEncoders to DerEncoder[].

methodNames: private byte[] decode(DerInputStream in) throws IOException
public void encode(byte tag, OutputStream out) throws IOException
public Object getAttributeValue(ObjectIdentifier oid) throws IOException
public Object getAttributeValue(String name) throws IOException
